argv: F=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; echo "=== detect_branch anywhere in live jj-lane.sh ==="; grep -n "detect_branch" $F/scripts/hyaku/jj-lane.sh; echo "grep rc=$?"; echo "=== branch-detection lines in live file ==="; grep -n "branch" $F/scripts/hyaku/jj-lane.sh | head -8; echo "=== file history ==="; git -C $F log --oneline --follow -- scripts/hyaku/jj-lane.sh | head -6; echo "=== detect_branch at older fleet revs ==="; for r in $(git -C $F log --format=%h -5 -- scripts/hyaku/jj-lane.sh); do echo "--- $r ---"; git -C $F show $r:scripts/hyaku/jj-lane.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -n "detect_branch" | head -2; done; echo done
